notes: Schema v2 (M5-01, DEC-006 decision 6). Top-level 'dependencies' entries are git submodules verified at configure time by cmake/MirageDependencies.cmake; nested_pins entries are verified against the gitlink recorded in the parent repository's HEAD; audit-only entries (no 'path' verification in parent HEAD) are informational. 'artifacts' entries are non-submodule binary pins (version + url + sha1 + size + license) validated structurally at configure; integrity is enforced when the artifact is acquired/consumed. 'frontend' registers the npm dependency tree: its lockfile sha256 is re-computed and compared at every configure, so any ui/package-lock.json drift without updating this registration fails the build. No unlocked binary may enter the default build (DEC-006 decision 6): a product target consuming a pinned artifact must resolve it through mirage_require_locked_artifact().

artifacts.name: cef

platforms.sha1_provenance: 官方 index.json 与 PoC 本地 sha1sum 双源一致（index 提取 2026-09-26；本地下载-摘要复核 2026-09-21，ui/shell-poc/versions.lock.json）
官方 index.json 与本地下载 sha1sum 双源一致（index 提取 2026-09-26；本地下载-摘要复核 2026-09-26，M5-02 首次消费，MirageCef.cmake configure 门禁以同值复核通过）

artifacts.license: BSD-3-Clause（libcef；内嵌 Chromium/Blink 及第三方组件清单见发行包 LICENSE.txt 与 chrome://credits，SBOM 导出随发布门禁 M5-11 接线）
artifacts.consumption: 构建期下载并校验 SHA 后解包，摘要不匹配即 configure 失败。当前产品默认构建无 CEF 消费目标（未锁定二进制不进默认构建，DEC-006 决策 6）；首个消费目标（M5-02 apps/desktop 壳）必须经 mirage_require_locked_artifact() 绑定本条目获取 URL 与摘要。

frontend.name: ui-frontend
frontend.lockfile_sha256_semantics: sha256 over the LF-normalized file content (identical to the committed blob); the configure gate normalizes CRLF before hashing so the check is invariant to checkout line endings
frontend.package_manager: npm（workspaces；CI 以 npm ci 安装，禁止裸 npm install 漂移）
frontend.license_manifest: 许可证清单由发布门禁生成（工程规范 10.5，随 M5-11 打包交付接线）
